description: Check voucher status for this merchant. Send one of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id (anyOf). If none is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier, an example, and next_action. Anonymous public lookup is GET /agent-api/vouchers/status.

code.description: Voucher code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

voucher_code.description: Alias of code. One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

voucher_id.description: Voucher UUID. One of code, voucher_code, or voucher_id is required.

name: check_voucher_status
title: Check Voucher Status
